title: Binance Completes the STEPN Subscription Launchpad and Will Open Trading for GMT
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has completed the subscription format Launchpad for STEPN  and the final token allocation results are now showing on the  STEPN Launchpad Page . A total of 130,672 participants committed 8,742,450.4131  BNB during the subscription period, representing an oversubscription of 828x.  12 participants reached the 1,500,000 GMT hard cap, resulting in the participants’ allocation being passed down to the remaining users. For further information on how this is calculated, refer to a detailed guide  here . As a reference for users that participated: Users that committed 50 BNB received an allocation of 2,422.9120 GMT and will have 0.06091201 BNB deducted. Users that committed 500 BNB received an allocation of 24,229.1206 GMT, and will have 0.60912009 BNB deducted. Users that committed 5,000 BNB received an allocation of 242,291.2061 GMT and will have 6.09120 BNB deducted. The corresponding BNB tokens will be deducted from your already-locked BNB balance within 30 minutes of this announcement. Once deducted, your GMT and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Binance will list STEPN (GMT) in the innovation zone and open trading for GMT/BTC, GMT/USDT, GMT/BNB and GMT/BUSD trading pairs at 2022-03-09 12:00 PM (UTC). Note: The token purchase price was set at 1 GMT = 0.00002514 BNB or 0.01 USD (using a BNB price of 397.9 USD), as per the previous announcement  here . The STEPN (GMT) SPL smart contract is available  here  and BEP-20 smart contract is available  here .
